name: pumi-heavy-terminals
description: Notice terminals whose processes eat the machine, and put them to sleep: the foreground job is suspended as ctrl+z would, and woken with fg.

interval.desc: How often every terminal is measured, in seconds.

cpu.desc: A terminal using more CPU than this (100 is one core) is heavy.

memory.desc: A terminal holding more memory than this, in MB, is heavy.

sustain.desc: How many checks in a row it must be heavy for.

auto_sleep.desc: Suspend its foreground job right away.
